def _v3_fix_fcst_log_header():
    """One-time migration: pre-v3 forecast-log header has 4 columns while v3
    appends 8 — pd.read_csv errors on any row WIDER than the header, which
    silently killed update_calibration + _v3_sync the moment the first v3 row
    landed (2026-08-06). Narrow old rows get NaN-padded by pandas, so widening
    the header line is the whole fix."""
    try:
        if not os.path.exists(V3_FCST_LOG):
            return
        with open(V3_FCST_LOG) as f:
            first = f.readline().strip()
        if first == "hour_et,blend,obs_f,graded":
            with open(V3_FCST_LOG) as f:
                rest = f.read()
            with open(V3_FCST_LOG, "w") as f:
                f.write("hour_et,blend,obs_f,graded,mean_f,model_mean_f,k_dir,mean_src\n" + rest)
            print("[v3] forecast log header widened to 8 cols")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[v3] header fix note (non-fatal): {e}")

_v3_fix_fcst_log_header()
_v3_load_k()
_v3_sync()
